name: dev-browser
description: Browser automation with persistent page state for development, testing, scraping, and debugging workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Automate browser workflows with persistent page state
interface.longDescription: Use Dev Browser to navigate sites, fill forms, take screenshots, inspect page state, scrape data, and test web apps through a local browser automation server. Standalone mode launches Chromium; extension mode can connect to an existing Chrome session when the user intentionally wants logged-in browser state.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-browser to test this local web app
Navigate this site and take a screenshot
Scrape this page with persistent browser state
